verdict.rationale: No first-party SDK documentation appears in the pack. The closest evidence is indirect: a community reply mentions an upcoming v2 of mcp-use, which preview URLs on run.mcp-use.com suggest is the framework behind server builds, and the official CLI builds and runs MCP servers locally. A REST API with API keys exists, but no OpenAPI spec was found, which limits generated or typed client libraries. Missing for 10: documented official SDKs (language coverage, install and reference docs), an explicit first-party link between Manufact and mcp-use, a published OpenAPI spec or typed API clients, and independent hands-on corroboration.
